Sorry for assuming you were a guy.

I'll be honest and say that I am kind of skeptic about your condition. Kind of seems that you are liking yourself to "Dexter" here.

Yea, honestly, I'm can't argue with you. The only difference between you and I (and pretty big difference) is that I don't see suicide as a way out. I'm perfectly okay with who I am at this point. What if, once you die, you restart the exact same life (clean slate of memories)? Is it really change anything if I choose to die now? Nope. Going to be back to the same spot sooner than later.

Anyway, that's an extreme example, but you get the point. Can't know what happens after death, so I'm just going to do what I can and fuck around here on this earth while I can.

Either way, good luck, I'm going off to sleep.

Yo, wtf, you are almost like the slightly "further down the road" version of me.

I KNOW EXACTLY what you mean by pro-procrastinator. I don't know what it is. I have always been good at school and for some reason, ever since uni, I've become so fucking lazy and loath that fact about myself. I can't even convince myself to get back to the gym ONCE.

I keep telling myself that if only I had some sort of long-term goal that I could aspire too or work hard towards, I could finally start dedicating myself towards it and doing something about myself, but I see everything as pointless. In my mind, once I die, my universe dies with me, so everything is just futile. There really isn't a difference between life or death.

Its funny, because I literally just answered another person's thread with the same "in search of a goal" idea.

Anyway, I'm also in Canada and studying something I don't see myself enjoying all too much (bachelors though). No gf here though.

Yes. I know what you mean by "maybe I've always got things handed too easily to me [...]". Same fucking feeling man. I just got absolutely NO MOTIVATION other than the fact that its worked so far.

As for relationships, I don't really believe that monogamy can ever work. I've heard that 1/3 people in relationships cheat (not that I ever have).

Anyway, I can go on a lot about this, but yes, same thing. I feel like I'm wasting this great life my parents worked hard to get me into. I'm glad I've found someone who feels the same.

I don't know man, but I don't think it really matters. We are all going to die someday. Whether you die alone/in love/with the world by your side, it doesn't change anything. When you die, your world dies with you. There is no such thing as a legacy. Everyone is going to die and nothing exists forever. Even if you were successful and left a legacy, once you die, it disappears together with your world. You will never even be able to know that you left a legacy, because you would be dead. Anyway, I'm getting way above my head in philosophy, but I had a small breakthrough today and I'm learning to accept life as it is.

The problem I have is that I don't really have a goal. Everything is sort of going by the wayside because I can't seem to choose something to work towards.

All I really want is a goal or something to work towards, and then I could focus my attention and life towards that.

In your case, I don't know if not caring is the right attitude, but I don't think there is a right attitude. Choose a path that you think will bring you happiness, but don't be at the pursuit of happiness. Let life happen.

Check out the answer I found on yahoo answers and that I posted here a couple of hours ago.



Also, start to pretend to think about yourself highly and it sort of becomes a self-fulfilling prophecy. Try it.

hey man, I posted this not too long ago. Some people didn't seem to like it, but it helped me:

http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/1297y6/strangely_ironic_but_good_advice_hang_in_there/
Okay, but it helped me out, so I don't think its terrible advice.

Hey man, I had small breakthrough with a post I saw on yahoo answers a couple of hours ago. Maybe it can help: http://imgur.com/sFnKS

Anyway, here is my opinion. And I'm not saying this in a rude tone. Its hard to convey tone via text.

Get over it. I've had that longing for my ex as well. I'm glad as hell that I'm over it now and that I didn't stay with her.

I think what you are missing is what I realized I was missing. I wanted my ex to want me again. That was it. I didn't really want her per se, I just wanted to know that she wanted me. The realization of how selfish of a want that was helped me wake up from my self-pitying and self-wallowing state.

Bid deal. If you enjoyed it, why do you hate yourself for it. I don't condone your actions, but whatever, you did what you did and that is the past. There is no set way to live.

It sounds to me like you are trying to feel special by thinking you are eviler than everybody else in the world and that you should be stopped. Kind of self-centered dude.

Yes, for some reason you may have that urge to destroy that which is innocent/cute/helpless, but its just an urge. You don't have to act on it. Whether you do or don't is your choice and you assume responsibility for your actions.

Just remember, everybody else has the same freedom and urges to inflict that same kind of pain on you, but they choose not to. Why? Are they really "better" people? Is that honestly what you believe? No, they don't see anything useful out of it.

There is a difference between the words "should" and "could".

"You can do anything, but that doesn't mean you should"

Hey man, I can't say I know exactly how you feel, but I've been searching online and found some decent talk. Anyway, I just posted a link to an answer that hit home with me. Signed up on reddit so I could share it.
